text:
Shayne Gostisbehere had a busy week in the headlines for a hit. His check on Lane Hutson on Nov 19 drew a reaction from the Canadiens, and Hutson scored the overtime winner, which Montreal fans enjoyed.

The hockey is going well. He has 19 points in 24 games, nine on the power play, and Carolina takes about 66% of the expected goals with him on at five on five. Ten points in his last ten games came on 6.8 expected, so the run is a little hot.

The bigger caveat is on-ice luck: the Hurricanes have scored 9.1 more goals than the chances deserve with him out there. Some of the point pace will drift back. Evolving-Hockey's note from last season holds: he drives play, and he plays with strong teammates, which flatters the raw numbers.

He's 33, in his second stint with Carolina, and a Stanley Cup winner last spring. What to watch: he's the power-play quarterback on a team that generates 0.87 expected goals a game with the extra man, so his points will track that unit.
